initial.name: walk
initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production animation sprite sheet, not a collage of independent illustrations. The reference is ONLY character/style identity, NOT its broken leg poses. Orange tabby small black eyes, pink ears, cream muzzle/chest/paw tips, warm brown bold outline, slender long body and modest head. EXACTLY 8 frames in a 4-column x 2-row grid of EQUAL cells, read left to right top to bottom. Transparent background. No text, grid lines, shadow, floor, hands, props. Every frame has exactly FOUR anatomically connected legs (two near-side, two darker far-side); never merge or drop limbs. Same head/ears/torso lengths, same coat stripes, same scale and local head anchor. Lock character identity. Keep ample blank padding. This is ONE continuous cyclic locomotion sampled at equal time intervals: frame 8 must lead continuously into frame 1. Do not duplicate frame 1 as frame 8. Side view, facing RIGHT. A relaxed feline WALK, NOT running or jumping. Keep back horizontal, head and tail base exactly fixed, constant gently raised curved tail, paws on a fixed ground line while in stance. Grounded paws translate steadily BACKWARD relative to torso; lifted paws bend and swing FORWARD. Eight phases with distinct near/far legs. Near foreleg: frame1 reaches FORWARD to contact, 2 planted under front shoulder, 3 planted behind shoulder, 4 lifts/bends rearward, 5 bent passing under chest, 6 swings forward, 7 reaches forward just off ground, 8 almost contacts forward. Far foreleg is offset FOUR frames from near foreleg. Near hindleg is offset TWO frames from near foreleg, far hindleg offset SIX. Each leg follows stance then swing. Most frames have 2-3 grounded paws. No body stretch or aerial flight. Forepaws and hindpaws visibly traverse full front-to-back arcs; not eight almost identical cats.

initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production animation sprite sheet, not a collage of independent illustrations. The reference is ONLY character/style identity, NOT its broken leg poses. Orange tabby small black eyes, pink ears, cream muzzle/chest/paw tips, warm brown bold outline, slender long body and modest head. EXACTLY 8 frames in a 4-column x 2-row grid of EQUAL cells, read left to right top to bottom. Transparent background. No text, grid lines, shadow, floor, hands, props. Every frame has exactly FOUR anatomically connected legs (two near-side, two darker far-side); never merge or drop limbs. Same head/ears/torso lengths, same coat stripes, same scale and local head anchor. Lock character identity. Keep ample blank padding. This is ONE continuous cyclic locomotion sampled at equal time intervals: frame 8 must lead continuously into frame 1. Do not duplicate frame 1 as frame 8. Side view, facing RIGHT. A coherent feline GALLOP, like a tiny running-cat silhouette with a real gather→push→flight→land→gather rhythm. Eight phases: 1 gathered body with hind paws planted beneath hips and forelegs folded; 2 hindlegs PUSH BACK against ground, forelegs reach FORWARD; 3 EXTENDED FLIGHT forelegs forward hindlegs backward, belly stretched; 4 forepaws contact FAR FORWARD, hindlegs trail backward; 5 forepaws support under shoulder, hindlegs swing FORWARD below belly; 6 forepaws PUSH BACK, hindlegs tuck FAR FORWARD; 7 compact gathered flight with all four legs tucked under torso, back gently arched; 8 hindpaws reach ground under hip ready for frame1. Keep head anchored at nearly same screen height (very slight pitch only), no head/eye size changes. Tail follows one smooth continuous arc, mostly backward and slightly raised, never teleports to upright. Anatomically credible front and back limb articulation. Do not simply reuse walk poses.

walkRepair: Animation repair, stylized-concept. Redraw this eight-frame orange tabby walk cycle to fix a critical fault: its HIND LEGS ARE FROZEN in almost the same position in all frames. Preserve the same slender orange character, cream paws and muzzle, brown outline, side view facing right, head/torso/ears/tail nearly identical, exactly eight frames in 4 columns by 2 rows, ample transparent margins and same scale. ONLY leg poses change. Both hind legs MUST clearly walk with alternating planting and forward swing, NOT remain stretched backward. Near hind paw (lighter): frame1 behind hip on ground, frame2 directly under hip on ground, frame3 IN FRONT of hip with knee bent swinging forward, frame4 reaching forward and planting, frame5 planted front of hip, frame6 directly under hip, frame7 behind hip lifting, frame8 bent returning under hip. Far hind paw darker, offset four frames, so when near rear paw is behind hip far rear paw is in FRONT. Forelegs likewise alternate forward contact, vertical support, backward stance, lifted bent forward recovery. ALL FOUR limbs visible and attached with real shoulder/elbow/hip/knee bends. Grounded paws fixed baseline, lifted paws above it. Keep body horizontal and fixed, no flight. This must be an animation cycle with every leg taking a complete step, not eight near duplicate illustrations. No labels, text, grid, shadows or floor. True transparent background.
runRepair: Preserve eight gallop phases and identity; shrink each cat to 75% inside its own equal cell with ample padding, and redraw the clipped fourth pose with all four paws fully present.
